interpret.need: Determine the count of campaigns that were active in the last 7 days, broken down by their lifecycle status.

task.goal: Count campaigns by status for the last 7 days

task_results.sql:
SELECT
    campaigns.status AS status,
    COUNT(*)::bigint AS campaigns_ran

FROM (
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.organization_id,
  c.branch_id,
  c.name,
  c.description,
  c.status,
  c.starts_at,
  c.ends_at,
  c.source_channel,
  c.created_by_user_id,
  c.created_at,
  c.updated_at,
  c.goal,
  c.objective,
  c.session_id,
  c.audience_summary,
  c.audience_count,
  c.launch_plan,
  c.launch_local_date,
  c.launch_local_time,
  c.timezone
FROM campaign.campaigns c
WHERE c.organization_id = 1012
  AND c.branch_id = 1004

) campaigns
WHERE TRUE
  AND (launch_local_date IS NOT NULL AND launch_local_date >= '2026-09-26' AND launch_local_date < '2026-10-03')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign.campaign_channels ch WHERE ch.campaign_id = campaigns.id AND ch.organization_id = 1012 AND ch.channel <> 'ppc')
  AND TRUE

  AND status IN ('live','completed','cancelled')
GROUP BY campaigns.status ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST
